title: CIEM: Contrastive Instruction Evaluation Method for Better Instruction Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: The paper measures this bias using the Contrastive Instruction Evaluation Method (CIEM), an automatic pipeline that leverages an LLM and annotated image-text datasets to generate factual and contrastive (non-existent or contradictory) question-answer pairs. Vision-Language Models are then evaluated as a binary classification task to determine their propensity to falsely answer 'Yes' to contrastive questions, using metrics such as Accuracy, Precision, Recall, Specificity, and F1-score.
